what: Whether the parts of the 11/5 release decided here are unchanged in Glazer et al.'s repository after Version 16 (pull request #31, open and not merged when checked): every file under construction/ and lean/, compared by git blob id at the pin and at the head.

reading: Version 16 is pull request #31 ("Version 16: incorporate the fourth Fable audit corrections", opened 2026-11-11 19:26 UTC, head 39182bff, open and not merged when checked; base 511529bb, the Version 15 head of main). By its description it corrects the manuscript in three places and leaves the constructions unchanged; its 48 added files (a manuscript, research/version16) are not checked here.
